title: C# .NET Developer
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team developing innovative software solutions for radiation oncology and healthcare workflows. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software products while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory requirements.
  
  
This role requires strong technical expertise in modern software development technologies, a passion for quality, and the ability to collaborate across global cross-functional teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, robust, and secure software applications and services.
* Contribute to system and software architecture decisions and provide effort estimations for development activities.
* Develop high-quality, maintainable, and testable code following engineering best practices.
* Implement and execute unit, integration, and automated tests as part of CI/CD pipelines.
* Investigate, analyze, and resolve software defects and production issues
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Verification, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and System Engineering teams.
* Ensure compliance with software development processes and applicable standards for regulated medical devices.
* Drive software quality initiatives and promote engineering excellence within the team.
* Mentor junior engineers and actively share technical knowledge across the organization.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and continuous improvement activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6+ years of professional software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, and modern software development practices
* Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and distributed applications.
* Experience with microservices, and container technologies.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, design patterns, and object-oriented design.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing software for regulated industries such as healthcare, medical devices, or life sciences.
* Experience with OAuth, OpenID Connect, and application security best practices.
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Exposure to automation frameworks and quality engineering practices.
* Foster a culture of quality, collaboration, and accountability.

**Who we are**
: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
  
  
**How we work**
: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
  
  
**Data Privacy**
: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

description:
**Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXR**
VenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds
*with*
LLMs rather than around them.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
Features, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js
  
  
Backend: Python, Django
  
  
AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building it

What we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.
  
  
**What You Need**

* One to two years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight.
* At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them

title: Product Engineer (Senior) — VenXR
description:
**Product Engineer (Senior) — Venxr**
Venxr builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Senior Product Engineer who builds
*with*
LLMs rather than around them — and can tell whether what they built actually works.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
Features, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goal, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.
  
  
At this level you also own the shape of things: the architecture calls that are expensive to reverse, the evaluation discipline that tells us whether an AI feature actually works, and the bar everyone else codes to.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js
  
  
Backend: Python, Django
  
  
AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupt. Not prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — golden sets, regression gates, and knowing the true quality of a system that answers differently every time. Harder than building it, and where most teams quietly give up
* Guardrails and injection — user-controlled text flows into your prompts. That's a threat surface, not a footnote
* Cost and latency budgets — token spend per node, where the p95 actually goes, what's worth caching
* Observability — tracing, prompt versioning, and being able to debug a wrong answer at 2am from traces alone
* Knowing when not to — the cases where deterministic code is correct and a model is a liability

What we want is someone who has owned an LLM system in production, with real users on it, and can tell us honestly where it was weak and why.
  
  
**What You Need**

* Three to five years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight
* An LLM system you owned in production with real users: the prompts, the orchestration, the failure modes, and the evaluation that proved it worked.
* An orchestration framework used in anger — LangGraph or equivalent, including the parts that broke
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and system design you can defend under disagreement
* Architecture judgement: you can name what you rejected and why, not just what you chose
* Technical leadership — code review, mentoring, raising the bar without being asked to
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve built/shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain
* Open-source work or writing we can read

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them
* Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business
* High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking
* Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully
* Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works
* Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked
* Vitality — energy that holds up in month six

Two of those carry extra weight at this level. Disagree and commit, because you'll be in the room where the calls get made. High standards, because yours become everyone's.
  
  
In practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.
  
  
**The process**
The take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for.
  
  

* Tech screening round — 30 minutes, mutual.
* Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system, plus the evidence it works. Over half the marks are for judgement rather than completeness, and a meaningful share for telling us where your own system is weak. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying.
* Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it.
* Interview round 2 –Technical + Managerial

**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. The Manager (L9), Enterprise Risk Analytics is an individual contributor role and will be responsible for providing reporting and visual analytics solutions based off the company’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system. This role is a key driver in transforming raw risk data into clear, actionable, and visually compelling reports and dashboards primarily using Tableau. The role will have a dotted line of reporting to the AVP – Enterprise Risk Analytics (US) while directly reporting into the Enterprise Risk Analytics Team in India, which rolls up into Synchrony Financial India.

* Lead the end-to-end development, implementation, and maintenance of advanced risk reports, dashboards, and visualizations primarily utilizing Tableau based on data extracted from the GRC system and related data sources

* Collaborate with senior leaders, risk managers, and governance functions to gather, understand, and translate complex business requirements into technical reporting specifications
* Present analytics findings and visualizations to stakeholders, clearly articulating the story behind the data to drive risk-informed decision-making
* Design and build data extracts and queries from the eGRC Data Mart to efficiently support complex risk analytics and reporting requirements
* Perform in-depth analysis of risk data to identify emerging trends, concentrations, and key risk indicators (KRIs) across the enterprise
* Perform other special tasks as needed

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 2-4 years of relevant experience in coding, reporting, or analytics. Or else 4-6 years of coding, reporting or analytics experience in lieu of a degree.
* 2+ years’ hands-on experience with Tableau
* 2+ years’ hands-on experience with one or more data analytics tools like SAS/SQL an Python etc.
* Strong written/oral communication skills.
* Proven ability to deliver Analytical solutions for Business problems.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM related or Business field.
* Experience in consumer credit/risk analytics role
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, organize workflow, and prioritize work assignments
* Working knowledge and experience with GenAI in workspace
* Commercially effective and collaborative across teams and functions
* Intermediate EXCEL skill-set

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 2-4 years of relevant experience in coding, reporting, or analytics. Or else 4-6 years of coding, reporting or analytics experience in lieu of a degree.

description:

JOB PURPOSE AND DECRIPTION
  
  
The purpose of this role is practical application of data science in supply chain planning and inventory management to improve underlaying processes and deliver financial value.

Job Description

**Business Analyst - Lab Informatics**

Location

India (Pune) | Work from Office

About Excelra

Excelra is a science-led, data-driven outcomes company with more than 20 years of experience in the pharmaceutical and life-sciences sector. Our Lab Informatics practice combines deep scientific expertise — including a team of PhD-level researchers — with hands-on delivery experience across ELN, LIMS, SDMS, and data migration programmes for 16 of the top 20 global pharma companies.

We act as a trusted client advocate, representing our clients' best interests in all vendor and technology interactions. This role sits within our Lab Informatics delivery team, embedded in a global Revvity Signals implementation and migration programme.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with a strong background in pharmaceutical R&D and laboratory informatics to join our delivery team on an exciting and high-priority engagement. The programme covers the migration from Biovia ELN to Revvity Signals (ELN, LIMS, DLX, VitroVivo) across six global R&D sites, along with data migration from legacy systems and full GXP validation (E3 / CSA framework).

The BA will act as the primary liaison between the client's R&D scientists and the Revvity implementation team, ensuring that the system is configured to serve the scientists' real-world needs — not simply what the vendor delivers by default.

**Key Responsibilities**

Requirements Gathering & Process Mapping

* Engage directly with R&D scientists across chemistry, biology, and formulation disciplines to elicit and document current workflows and pain points.
* Translate scientific processes into structured IT and configuration requirements for Revvity Signals (Notebook, LIMS, DLX, VitroVivo modules).
* Map existing Biovia ELN and Cispro workflows to the target Revvity data model, identifying gaps and proposing solutions.
* Produce and maintain detailed requirements documentation, use cases, and process flow diagrams.

**Vendor & Programme Coordination**

* Serve as the client's advocate in all interactions with the Revvity implementation team, challenging vendor-led decisions where they do not serve the client's operational needs.
* Coordinate closely with the Data Migration Specialist (using the Intly AI migration tool) and the CSV/Validation Specialist to ensure requirements, migration, and validation streams are aligned.
* Participate in programme governance and status reviews, flagging risks and dependencies proactively.

**Change Management & Training**

* Develop change management plans for each site rollout, ensuring end-user buy-in and readiness prior to go-live.
* Design and deliver end-user training (scientists and lab managers) for the Revvity Signals platform across all six global sites.
* Create training materials, user guides, and quick-reference documentation in collaboration with the client's IT team.

**User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**

* Plan and facilitate UAT cycles at each site, ensuring test scenarios accurately reflect scientific workflows.
* Log, track, and drive resolution of defects and configuration issues identified during UAT.
* Obtain formal sign-off from site representatives ahead of each go-live.

GXP Compliance Awareness

* Work within a fully GXP-validated environment (100% of sites are GXP; E3/CSA approach adopted).
* Ensure all requirement changes and configuration decisions are appropriately documented to support IQ/OQ/PQ activities led by the validation specialist.
* Maintain traceability between user requirements, system configurations, and test evidence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

Essential

* Master's degree or above in a life-sciences field (Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, or equivalent).
* 8+ years' experience as a Business Analyst in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO environment, with direct exposure to R&D or laboratory functions.
* Hands-on experience with ELN or LIMS systems (Biovia, Revvity Signals, IDBS, LabVantage, or similar).
* Demonstrable experience conducting requirements workshops with scientific stakeholders and producing formal requirement documents.
* Familiarity with GXP-regulated environments and an understanding of validation concepts (IQ, OQ, PQ, UAT in a validated context).
* Strong communication skills — able to translate between scientific language and IT/vendor terminology with equal fluency.

Preferred

* Direct experience with Revvity Signals (Notebook, LIMS, or DLX modules).
* Exposure to data migration projects, particularly migrating from Biovia ELN or similar legacy ELN platforms.
* Certification in Business Analysis (ECBA, CCBA, or CBAP).
* Experience working in a vendor-agnostic advisory or consulting capacity on behalf of a pharma client.
* Familiarity with the E3 (Enterprise, Existing, Experienced) computer software assurance framework.
* Working knowledge of instrument integration concepts (LIMS/DLX connectivity, chromatography data systems).

description:
**Job Title: Senior Business Analyst**
**Location: Pune, India**
We are looking for a talented and passionate Senior Business Analyst to join our Researcher Communications team in SN Digital (SND), a technology division of Springer Nature.
  
  
The team supports researchers in discovering relevant content, identifying opportunities to publish, and staying up to date on the impact of their work through a seamless multi-channel communication experience. This work drives key business goals to grow content consumption and submissions.
  
  
**About Springer Nature**
Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and @SpringerNature.
  
  
**About Us**
SN Digital has 230 people based in London, Berlin, Lisbon, Pune, New York, Madrid, Dordrecht, and Heidelberg. We work in collaborative, multi-disciplinary delivery teams, developing digital products and services that answer user problems and support business goals.
  
  
The work is exciting and meaningful.
  
  
Our culture is collaborative and friendly.
  
  
We encourage and support growth, both personal and professional.
  
  
Having a good command of English is essential; collaboration is vital in our day to day work, so being able to communicate your ideas and understand others is critical.
  
  
This role is a terrific opportunity for friendly, curious people who want to get involved in our work, who love to learn, who will embrace and develop our culture, and help make SND a place where people and ideas can thrive.
  
  
We are intentionally looking to create teams that are diverse and inclusive. Diversity is the mix of culture, background, experience and personality that we all bring; inclusion is getting the mix to work better together. We want every team member to contribute to our shared goals while respecting each other's skills, knowledge and needs.
  
  
**The way we do business**
We build our software incrementally, iteratively, and continuously, so you’ll be able to see new work go live to over four million visitors around the globe every week. Our flavour of agile has been heavily influenced by XP and Kanban, and if something isn’t working, we change it.
  
  
Our work delivers value to both the business and our customers, our teams are cross-discipline: business analysts and the user experience team work with stakeholders to coordinate research and understand requirements, whilst our frontend developers and software engineers pair with quality analysts to develop the most robust solutions, and our platform engineers work across the organisation to ensure our infrastructure never lets us down.
  
  
We generally follow a mix of agile and lean practices with an overall philosophy towards continuous delivery. We’ll rely on each and everyone’s expertise to adapt and improve these processes to serve the team, project and company as best fit their current contexts.
  
  
Visit sndigital.springernature.com to learn more about who we are and what we do.
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional agile delivery team, leveraging analysis tools to inform decisions that support both business objectives and user needs. You will collaborate closely with both your team and business stakeholders to understand complex business problems, define work and identify key opportunities.

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior**
**Description**
EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.
  
  
Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
  
  
Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end-to-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
  
  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery & Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators

Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
* Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
* Perform data profiling and fit-for-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
* Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA-CCR, and operational risk.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
* Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source-to-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
* Map data elements to Axiom-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.
* Assist in the design, build, and testing of interim ERBA calculators using available UCL data and direct source-system data until strategic UCL feeds are available.
* Support testing of calculator outputs, reconciliation of data and results, fit-for-use analysis, issue identification, remediation tracking, and user acceptance testing using project accelerators and agreed testing approaches.
* Identify and document controls for new or modified data elements, including preventative and detective controls, data quality checks, lineage controls, reconciliation points, and governance documentation.
* Recommend interim and strategic BAU data capture, data management, and process enhancements to support ERBA, SCCL gross exposure measurements, regulatory reporting, management reporting, and future-state capital insights.
* Coordinate with exposure pods, technology teams, and business stakeholders to drive agile execution across discovery, assessment, design, build, testing, and refinement sprints.
* Prepare clear, executive-ready documentation including requirements packs, mapping documents, control matrices, testing summaries, issue trackers, status decks, and steering committee materials.
* Responsibly use AI and automation tools to improve analysis, documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and delivery transparency while following engagement and client requirements.

**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must-have:**

* Master’s degree in business administration, finance, economics, engineering, statistics, information systems, or a related discipline, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in banking, consulting, risk management, regulatory capital, data management, or regulatory reporting.
* Strong understanding of Basel III / Basel III Endgame / Basel III Proposal requirements, ERBA concepts, RWA calculations, regulatory capital, credit risk, counterparty credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory reporting processes.
* Experience supporting Basel implementation, gap assessments, regulatory capital transformation, data sourcing, calculation logic documentation, data quality remediation, or regulatory reporting change programs.
* Strong business and data analysis skills, including requirements documentation, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, data lineage, data dictionaries, metadata management, reconciliation, and control documentation.
* Ability to understand exposure-level requirements across residential mortgage, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet exposures, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, SA-CCR, and operational risk.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Credit, Technology, Data, Operations, Compliance, and business teams in a structured and professional manner.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical data, logic, controls, testing, and implementation deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in preparing executive-ready PowerPoint materials, Excel trackers, meeting notes, governance reports, requirements documents, and testing summaries.
* Demonstrated focus on delivery excellence, attention to detail, process discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.

**Good-to-have:**

* Experience with Axiom, regulatory capital calculators, RWA engines, regulatory reporting platforms, or capital data warehouses.
* Technical skills such as SQL, SAS, Python, advanced Excel, data profiling tools, data visualization tools, or cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, GCP, or similar environments.
* Familiarity with UCL / data factory delivery concepts, source-to-target reconciliation, consumption views, semantic layers, data model design, ADRS unification, and ETL design documentation.
* Familiarity with SA-CCR, SCCL, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, securitization capital rules, corporate / wholesale banking products, and operational risk SMA / BIC concepts.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer – MERN | AWS | AI-Assisted Engineering

Company: YAGY Tech Pvt. Ltd.

Products: Mealawe | DeskDyne | Navmool

Location: Pune

Work Mode: Full-Time | Work From Office

Experience: 4–6 Years

CTC: ₹8–12 LPA + Other Benefits

About YAGY Tech

YAGY Tech is a growing FoodTech and SaaS company building technology products across consumer food delivery, enterprise cafeteria management and supply-chain operations.

Our products include:

Mealawe — a technology platform for fresh, home-style meals and subscriptions.

DeskDyne — an enterprise cafeteria and workplace food-management platform used by corporates, institutions and large workplaces.

Navmool — our food sourcing and supply-chain platform.

We operate with a lean product and engineering team where engineers are expected to take real ownership — from architecture and development to testing, deployment and production performance.

We are now looking for a strong Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building production systems rather than working on only one small part of the technology stack.

What You’ll DoFull Stack Engineering

* Build and maintain production applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js and Node.js
* Design APIs, backend services and responsive frontend experiences
* Own features from requirement understanding through development, testing and deployment
* Write clean, maintainable and scalable code using strong OOP and DSA fundamentals
* Participate in architecture and technical decision-making

AI-Assisted Development

AI-assisted engineering is an important part of our development workflow.

You will be expected to use modern coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools to accelerate development, debugging, testing and code review — without compromising engineering quality.

Performance & Scalability

* Identify and resolve application performance bottlenecks
* Design and optimize MongoDB/DynamoDB schemas, queries and indexes
* Build systems considering scalability, reliability and load from the beginning
* Monitor and troubleshoot production applications

Cloud & DevOps

* Develop and deploy applications on AWS
* Work with services such as EC2, S3, DynamoDB and CloudWatch
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines
* Work with Docker and containerized environments
* Exposure to Kubernetes will be an advantage

Web & Mobile

* Build experiences across web and mobile platforms
* Work with device/native capabilities where required
* Exposure to Angular, Ionic or Capacitor will be an advantage as parts of our existing production ecosystem use these technologies

Architecture

* Contribute to service architecture and scalability decisions
* Work on gradually evolving applications from monolithic to service-oriented/microservices architecture where appropriate

What We Absolutely Need

* 4–6 years of professional software development experience
* Strong hands-on experience with React.js
* Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and Express.js
* Strong experience with MongoDB
* Experience building and deploying production applications
* Hands-on experience with AWS or equivalent cloud infrastructure
* Understanding of MongoDB schema design, indexes and query optimization
* Experience with REST APIs and backend architecture
* Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines
* Unit and integration testing discipline
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
* Ability to take ownership of a feature from requirement to production
* Comfortable working from our Pune office
* Regular exposure to modern AI-assisted software-development tools

Good to Have

* DynamoDB
* Angular
* Ionic / Capacitor
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Microservices
* Android/iOS native capability integrations
* GitHub Actions
* Performance and load optimization
* Consumer internet, FoodTech, e-commerce or SaaS product experience

Who Will Do Well Here?

You will probably enjoy working with us if you:

* Prefer ownership over waiting for detailed instructions
* Can move comfortably between frontend, backend, database and cloud
* Think about performance before something becomes a production problem
* Are comfortable debugging real production issues
* Use AI tools to become a better and faster engineer rather than simply generating code
* Can explain technical trade-offs clearly
* Enjoy working in a fast-moving startup environment
* Want to work closely with Product, Design and the founding team

This is not a role for someone looking to work only on frontend tickets or only on backend APIs.

We are looking for an engineer who can own the complete journey from idea → architecture → code → test → deployment → production.

* If that sounds like the way you like to build products, we’d like to hear from you.
